I presented *Forensic Astrobiology: Experimentally Assessing the Preservation of
Microorganisms Encompassing Hydrothermal Vent Systems* at the **Astrobiology Science
Conference (AbSciCon) 2024**, together with J.-P. Duda, A. Kappler and M. Mansor.
